values.note: $5 per extra vehicle (first 2 free); double occupancy charged for a second camping unit. Cash or check at the fee station, or Scan and Pay.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/racetrack-campground-and-picnic-area ('Single Site: $15 per night, Additional Vehicle: $5 per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10250629 ('The camping fee is $15 per night', 'Extra vehicle charge $5 per day (first 2 vehicles are free)') + /rates (2026-05-23 to 2026-10-01: $15), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/racetrack-campground-and-picnic-area ('The campground has 13 units. The maximum recommended trailer length for the area is 22 feet.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Hand-pump water. No garbage service: pack it out.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10250629 ('A water pump and two vault restrooms are on site'; amenity 'Drinking Water (hand pump)') + Forest Service page ('Vault toilet(s)', 'Potable water is available', 'There is no garbage service at this site'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The two official pages differ: Forest Service 'Open seasonally, May through September as weather permits'; recreation.gov 'accessible late May through mid-November, depending on weather conditions'.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/racetrack-campground-and-picnic-area (Seasons of Use, page last updated August 31, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10250629 (Facilities), read 2026-10-22

values.note: First-come only: 'Visitors are required to physically arrive at the campground to purchase and claim a site.' Site must be occupied the first night.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10250629 ('This location is available on a first-come, first-served basis only', 'Camping stay limit is 16 days') + Forest Service page ('First come-first served'), read 2026-10-22

note: Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF (Pintler RD), about 11 mi south of Deer Lodge off I-90, 11 mi up Forest Road 169 from the Racetrack exit. Sites in mixed conifers along Racetrack Creek, private feel; group/day-use picnic area. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page + recreation.gov (Forest Service, Pintler RD; FCFS only): confirmed 13 sites, 22-ft max trailer (fits EKKO per the 22-ft rule), vault toilets, water, $15, first-come; added 16-night limit; season close 09-08 (a calendar edge) cleared because the pages say 'May through September' (FS) and 'late May through mid-November' (rec.gov), both recorded in season.note. Phone 406-859-3211 matches. Only the standing food-storage and pallet orders in alerts. Note trimmed of restated values.
